note: Formdazzle! adds fine-grained Twig theme suggestions to forms, form elements and labels, each suffixed with the form-id and element name (e.g. input--textfield--webform-contact--first-name). It has NO persistent per-site configuration of its own; its only stateful knobs are (a) whether the module is enabled and (b) its module weight in core.extension (formdazzle_install sets it to 10 so it runs after other hook_form_alter implementations). The medium/hard cases are therefore grounded in those two real live-state levers: module weight (read/verified from core.extension) and the actual rendered theme suggestion on a live core form (the user login form's username element gains the suffix __user_login_form__name only when formdazzle is enabled). Verify scripts render the login form via the form builder and inspect #theme, or read the module weight. The enable/disable hard case restores baseline (enabled at weight 10) in its cleanup.

evals.prompt: What extra Twig template suggestions does the Drupal Formdazzle! (formdazzle) module add for form elements, compared to core? Give an example for a textfield.
evals.expected_output: It adds suggestions that include the form ID and the element name, e.g. input--textfield--webform-contact.html.twig and input--textfield--webform-contact--first-name.html.twig, where core only offered input.html.twig and input--textfield.html.twig. Labels get matching suggestions too.

evals.prompt: How does the formdazzle module add its form template suggestions, and why does it set its module weight so high on install?
evals.expected_output: On hook_form_alter it stores the form id and appends a #pre_render callback (Dazzler::preRenderForm) that traverses the render array at pre-render time (after all other alters) and appends the suggestions. It sets its module weight to 10 (and uses hook_module_implements_alter) so its form_alter runs after other modules'.

evals.prompt: With formdazzle enabled and Twig debugging on, how can I see the template suggestions for a form, including the top-level form template that Drupal normally hides?
evals.expected_output: Enable Twig debug; formdazzle injects an HTML '<!-- FILE NAME SUGGESTIONS: ... -->' comment (via #markup) for the top-level form element, which core normally omits, and the per-element suggestions appear as usual in the page source Twig debug comments.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live configuration and report the module weight assigned to the formdazzle module in core.extension.
evals.expected_output: The formdazzle module weight in core.extension is 7 (read core.extension module.formdazzle, e.g. drush cget core.extension module.formdazzle, or \Drupal::config('core.extension')->get('module.formdazzle')).

evals.prompt: formdazzle is enabled on this site. Render the user login form on the live site and report the full formdazzle-added theme suggestion that appears on the username field element (the one ending in the element name).
evals.expected_output: The username element's #theme gains formdazzle's suffix, e.g. input__email__user_login_form__name (template input--email--user-login-form--name.html.twig): the form id is user_login_form and the element name is name.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site's forms are not getting Formdazzle's fine-grained per-form template suggestions. Make the site produce them again so that the rendered user login form's username element carries a form-id + element-name theme suggestion. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Install/enable the formdazzle module (drush en formdazzle -y). Once enabled, the rendered user login form's username element #theme includes formdazzle's __user_login_form__name suggestion.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, formdazzle's module weight has been changed so it no longer runs after other modules' form_alter hooks. Restore formdazzle to the weight its installer uses so it runs last. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set formdazzle's module weight to 10 (module_set_weight('formdazzle', 10); or reinstall the module, whose hook_install sets weight 10). core.extension module.formdazzle should then be 10.
